What if you ate burnt toast every day?
Toast is one of the most popular breakfasts in the world. A little crunch never hurt, right? Lots of people like their toast dark and crispy.

But here's the twist. Burnt toast has more acrylamide, a chemical linked to cancer in animal studies, so the UK food agency says go for golden, not dark brown! It forms when starchy foods like bread and fries cook at very high heat. Coffee, chips and fries also contain acrylamide, so it's about not overdoing it.
